import unicodedata

def is_palindrome(text: str) -> bool:
    """Return True if the given text is a palindrome when considering only letters and digits,
    ignoring case and accents."""
    # Decompose Unicode characters to separate base letters and accents
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', text)
    # Build a clean string: keep alphanumerics, ignore combining accents, convert to lowercase
    cleaned = [
        c.lower()
        for c in normalized
        if unicodedata.category(c)[0] != 'M' and c.isalnum()
    ]
    cleaned_str = ''.join(cleaned)
    return cleaned_str == cleaned_str[::-1]
